# krcw: paced
# KRCW core on_actions (generated by content_core.py)
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			set_global_flag = KRCW_active
			random_country = { krcw_init_global_vars = yes }
			random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.1 days = 3 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.2 days = 223 random_days = 8 } }
			DDR = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.10 days = 270 random_days = 8 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.30 days = 623 random_days = 12 } }
			SOV = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.32 days = 1386 random_days = 12 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.40 days = 1539 random_days = 1 } }
			SOV = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.49 days = 1589 random_days = 1 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.160 days = 1613 random_days = 1 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.161 days = 1627 random_days = 1 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.162 days = 1643 random_days = 1 } }
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.163 days = 1656 random_days = 1 } }
			random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.70 days = 591 } }
			random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.71 days = 870 } }
			random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.72 days = 1263 } }
			random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.73 days = 1479 } }
			PSA = {
				set_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti = 10 }
				set_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ma = 10 }
				country_event = { id = krcw_world.80 days = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_FRA = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.krcw_tension > 89 } NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_midnight_news } }
				set_global_flag = KRCW_midnight_news
				random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.76 days = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				# a thaw needs time after the 1946 ceasefires: not before 1952 (historical date; pace.py maps it)
				limit = { date > 1950.10.12 check_variable = { global.krcw_detente > 59 } NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_thaw_news } }
				set_global_flag = KRCW_thaw_news
				random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.77 days = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_PSA = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned } NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_psa_neutral_guaranteed } is_subject = no is_in_faction = no }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_psa_long_death_seen } OR = { has_global_flag = KRCW_long_dead date > 1951.9.11 } }
					set_country_flag = krcw_psa_long_death_seen
					country_event = { id = krcw_world.85 days = 3 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { krcw_route_random = yes has_country_flag = krcw_psa_long_death_seen }
					random_list = {
						35 = { add_to_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti = 4 } }
						40 = { add_to_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ma = 4 } }
						25 = { }
					}
					clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ti min = 0 max = 100 }
					clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ma min = 0 max = 100 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti > 99 } check_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti > krcw_psa_lean_ma } }
					country_event = { id = krcw_world.81 days = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ma > 99 } }
					country_event = { id = krcw_world.82 days = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = KRCW_act2_over
						OR = { krcw_route_historical = yes check_variable = { global.krcw_detente > 49 } }
					}
					set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_neutral_guaranteed
					krcw_detente_up_small = yes
					random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.84 days = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
